answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a reef as the anchor of the cost.
